checked_scope: The gain-map fixed point and the bounded-treewidth dynamic program, including arithmetic and mixed-support limits.
checks: At a fixed point, g_ia=x_ia G_i; positive G_i would make every supported pure payoff exceed its own weighted mean, a contradiction. Zero gains are exactly Nash equilibrium for the multilinear potential.

Tree-decomposition messages sum each factor once and optimize children conditional on the bag/separator. Running intersection prevents conflicts among remaining child variables. Enumerating bag assignments costs O((L+#bags)q^(w+1)) operations under explicit table representation.

Each DP value sums at most L rational inputs and has polynomial bit length. The coordination example refutes rounding arbitrary mixed equilibria; only mixed global potential maxima have all supported pure profiles globally optimal. Circuit arithmetic remains limited to the stated disjoint-subcircuit convention.
